title: Integrating Heterogeneous Echocardiography AI Outputs in Language Space: Learnable Late Fusion with a Supervised LLM
summary: Patient-level 3-fold OOF results are comparable to best report-rule/LightGBM strategies and outperform an untuned general-purpose LLM; no material superiority over best baseline is claimed. This is the result-bearing preprint version dated 2026-10-29; peer-review status is not established by the reviewed source.
ai_technology: Supervised LLM combines view-specific finding statements and measurements for four echocardiographic targets; retrospective single-center cohort is 859 exams from 646 patients.

evidence.tested: Patient-level 3-fold OOF results are comparable to best report-rule/LightGBM strategies and outperform an untuned general-purpose LLM; no material superiority over best baseline is claimed. Patient-level splits and out-of-fold predictions validate within this cohort; source explicitly limits generalization because no external institution/future-period cohort was tested.
evidence.unknown: nostic-validation result, not evidence of clinical benefit or external generalization.
